_agi_canonical.title: The Market Maker Game Theory
_agi_canonical.bar: strictly harder than L10 anchors; >=3 AGI properties; strategy not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: FastBot proves tight spreads are loss-making under toxic flow. WideBot proves wider spreads are profitable. A 32 bps half-spread is inside WideBot's 50 bps half-spread equivalent but far outside FastBot. Gross capture is 4,000,000*12%*0.0032 = 1,536. Subtract 600 toxic losses and about 200 inventory cost to get 736 expected daily PnL. Updating around 80 ms avoids pretending to beat a 30 ms toxic trader while still cancelling stale quotes.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All required strategy fields must match and all numeric fields must fall inside tolerance/range.
